content.overview: Section 2(kk) defines lay-off as the failure, refusal or inability of an employer to give employment to a workman on the muster rolls for listed reasons.
content.glance: Section 2(kk) defines lay-off as the failure, refusal or inability of an employer to give employment to a workman on the muster rolls for listed reasons.
content.study: Lay-off is the employer's failure, refusal or inability to give employment to a workman whose name is on the muster rolls, for shortage of coal, power or raw materials, accumulation of stocks, breakdown of machinery, natural calamity, or any other connected reason. Compensation is dealt with in section 25C.
